crypto-sculpture.jpg.description: Custom conceptual Ethereum sculpture, generated with the built-in imagegen tool.
crypto-sculpture.jpg.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a high-resolution editorial crypto image for a sophisticated university prediction-markets website; final composition square, 2048 x 2048. Create an art-directed, tactile studio still life: a monumental Ethereum diamond made of polished, scratched chrome floating just above a fractured black circuit-board slab. Exposed copper traces radiate outward across the slab like an intricate city grid. The diamond is the unmistakable primary subject, centered, fully inside the central 60% of the composition so it remains legible in both a square image panel and a wide website banner. Near-black studio background; one hard white spotlight and restrained molten-copper reflections from beneath. Beautifully controlled reflections, real machining marks, deep shadows, fine analog grain, razor-sharp material detail, dramatic architectural scale, premium contemporary magazine photography. Physical, unusual, austere, striking. Full color with silver, black and copper. No words, no interface, no labels, no stock-market chart, no floating gold coins, no neon purple, no watermark, no poster layout.
